answer: Besides endothelium, TML macrophages co-locate with Schwann cells (in the early neurovascular microenvironment, ME1) and with WNT2+ fibroblasts in early prenatal skin (6-8 PCW).
support_quote: TML macrophages were also predicted to co-locate with Schwann cells in prenatal skin (‘early neurovascular microenvironment’, ME1) (Figs. 1d and 3g) and expressed genes related to cell migration and neural development
